> **0.1.3** is 0.1.2 built on the latest wrapper and includes the Q-Link and automation fix (#486–#489): Q-Links now move parameters on the track's automation screen. Nothing else changed. Installs over 0.1.2 in place.

GAIAXXL: a three-tone virtual-analog synth for Akai Force / MPC OS 3.x, modelled on the discontinued Roland GAIA SH-01
(not affiliated with Roland).

Install: copy the zip to the device, unzip it and run `install.sh` as root (it stops and restarts MPC), or follow
INSTALL.md inside the zip. Manual: docs/USER_GUIDE.md. What changed: CHANGELOG.md.
